description: Resolve up to 50 scientific names to GBIF backbone taxon keys in one call — the batch counterpart to gbif_match_species for checklist, inventory, and species-list workflows that would otherwise need one round trip per name. Each name is matched independently and results are returned in input order, one entry per processed name. By default, an oversized batch processes the first 50 and returns the remainder in unprocessedNames. A name GBIF matched at a higher rank yields matchType HIGHERRANK with a note naming the taxon matched and what its taxonKey covers: that whole taxon, or its accepted taxon when it is a synonym — a misspelled species can fall back to its genus or kingdom at a confidence above 90, and a bare genus name carries the label too, matched as that genus. A name with no backbone match yields matchType NONE (no taxonKey) instead of failing the batch, with a note carrying GBIF's explanation when it gives one, such as several equal matches for a name shared across kingdoms; a per-name lookup failure yields matchType ERROR carrying that name's error message and, when the failure was classified, a machine-readable reason — the rest of the batch is unaffected, and the call as a whole still succeeds. When the name GBIF matched is a synonym — the queried name, or the higher taxon a HIGHERRANK match falls back to — taxonKey is the accepted taxon it resolves to and matchedTaxonKey carries the synonym's own key. Common names are not supported — use gbif_search_species for vernacular searches. Below confidence 80, review the match.

names.description: Scientific names to match against the GBIF backbone. Up to 50 are matched in parallel; additional names are returned in unprocessedNames when read-limit clamping is enabled (default). Every submitted name must be valid.

items.description: A scientific name to match, e.g. "Panthera leo".

strict.description: When true, require an exact match for every name (no fuzzy matching). When false (default), GBIF applies fuzzy matching to tolerate minor misspellings.

name: gbif_bulk_match_species

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Requested and applied batch size when names exceed the 50-name workload cap.

results.description: One result per processed input name, in input order (at most 50).

items.description: Match outcome for one input name.

canonicalName.description: Matched scientific name without authorship. Absent when unmatched.

confidence.description: Match confidence 0–100. Below 80 warrants review; a HIGHERRANK match can score above 90, so read matchType too. Absent on ERROR.

error.description: Failure message when matchType is ERROR. Absent otherwise.

matchType.description: EXACT or FUZZY for a match; HIGHERRANK when GBIF matched at a higher rank — a misspelled species falls back to its genus or kingdom, and a bare genus name carries it too — so taxonKey covers that whole taxon, or its accepted taxon when it is a synonym (see note); NONE when GBIF found no usable match; ERROR when the lookup itself failed for this name (see error).

matchedTaxonKey.description: Backbone key of the name that actually matched. Present only when it differs from taxonKey — that is, when a synonym was resolved to its accepted taxon.

name.description: The input name this entry corresponds to.

note.description: On HIGHERRANK, names the taxon and rank GBIF matched and what taxonKey covers: that whole taxon, or its accepted taxon when it is a synonym. On NONE, GBIF's own explanation when it gave one — for a name shared across kingdoms, its report of several equal matches, with a pointer to retry that name through gbif_match_species with kingdom. Absent on EXACT, FUZZY, and ERROR entries, and on a NONE GBIF did not explain.

rank.description: Taxonomic rank of the matched taxon.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure identifier when matchType is ERROR and the failure was classified. Absent when the failure carried no classification, and absent on every non-ERROR entry.

scientificName.description: Full matched scientific name with authorship. Absent when unmatched.

status.description: Taxonomic status: ACCEPTED, SYNONYM, or DOUBTFUL.

taxonKey.description: GBIF backbone taxon key to pass to gbif_search_occurrences, gbif_count_occurrences, and gbif_occurrence_facets — the accepted taxon's key when the name GBIF matched is a synonym, otherwise the matched taxon's own key. Absent when matchType is NONE or ERROR.

unprocessedNames.description: Names beyond the first 50, in original order including duplicates. Submit these names in another call. Absent when every name was processed.

title: Bulk Match Species Names
